column1: # What this fixture proves, independently of the reference: '+' rows must be
# present and '-' rows absent. Fields: sign, kind, source, target, strategy or
# local name; '*' matches anything. TEXTUAL rows are the reference engine's own
# textual edges, as recorded in expected.tsv; SITE rows are the interface's facts.
# The member guard's one exemption: a receiver rooted at self (an object the class
# owns) keeps a unique-name binding. A receiver passed in does not, nor does a
# self-rooted call to a name that is a builtin type's own method. The interface keeps
# the two facts apart, so the exemption can be applied exactly.
